data.what_it_does: Provides a Matrix Dart SDK for connecting to Matrix homeservers, handling chat functionalities, and supporting end-to-end encryption via vodozemac.
use_when: You are building a chat application or client that connects to the Matrix protocol.
You need a Dart-based Matrix SDK supporting multi-platform deployment including mobile, web, and desktop.
avoid_when: You are looking for general HTTP networking without the Matrix protocol constraints.
You do not need end-to-end encryption or Matrix homeserver connectivity.
strengths: Comprehensive Matrix protocol and VoIP support in Dart.
Cross-platform support spanning Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Requires native library configuration (vodozemac) for end-to-end encryption.
AGPL-3.0 license may pose restrictions for proprietary apps.
data.setup_notes: For end-to-end encryption, the vodozemac native library must be provided (e.g. via the flutter_vodozemac package).
